versions.changelog:
- Initial release of lygo-cli-bridge v1.0.0.
- Provides a unified CLI entrypoint: lygo health | map | analyze | mint | radar | next.
- Wraps kickstart, ops-detector, mint-walkthrough, and deception-radar without exposing internal layouts.
- In-process imports only—no subprocesses or shell access.
- Strict permission model: limited HTTPS GET, optional filesystem writes with consent, no auto-publish.
- Designed for local-first lattice workflows; complements other lygo protocol stack skills.
